verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.43
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.43

verses.pali: 5. Muṇḍarājavagga
verses.english: 5. With King Muṇḍa

verses.pali: Iṭṭhasutta
verses.english: Likable

verses.pali: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṁ gahapatiṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the householder Anāthapiṇḍika went up to the Buddha, bowed, and sat down to one side. The Buddha said to him:

verses.pali: “Pañcime, gahapati, dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Householder, these five things, which are likable, desirable, and agreeable are hard to get in the world.

verses.pali: Katame pañca?
verses.english: What five?

verses.pali: Āyu, gahapati, iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṁ;
verses.english: Long life,

verses.pali: vaṇṇo iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṁ;
verses.english: beauty,

verses.pali: sukhaṁ iṭṭhaṁ kantaṁ manāpaṁ dullabhaṁ lokasmiṁ;
verses.english: happiness,

verses.pali: yaso iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṁ;
verses.english: fame,

verses.pali: saggā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: and heaven.

verses.pali: Ime kho, gahapati, pañca dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: These are the five things, which are likable, desirable, and agreeable, but hard to get in the world.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, gahapati, pañcannaṁ dhammānaṁ iṭṭhānaṁ kantānaṁ manāpānaṁ dullabhānaṁ lokasmiṁ na āyācanahetu vā patthanāhetu vā paṭilābhaṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: And I say that these five things are not got by supplication or wishing for them.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, gahapati, pañcannaṁ dhammānaṁ iṭṭhānaṁ kantānaṁ manāpānaṁ dullabhānaṁ lokasmiṁ āyācanahetu vā patthanāhetu vā paṭilābho abhavissa, ko idha kena hāyetha?
verses.english: If they were, who would lack them?

verses.pali: Na kho, gahapati, arahati ariyasāvako āyukāmo āyuṁ āyācituṁ vā abhinandituṁ vā āyussa vāpi hetu.
verses.english: A noble disciple who wants to live long ought not pray for it, or hope for it, or pine for it.

verses.pali: Āyukāmena, gahapati, ariyasāvakena āyusaṁvattanikā paṭipadā paṭipajjitabbā.
verses.english: Instead, they should practice the way that leads to long life.

verses.pali: Āyusaṁvattanikā hissa paṭipadā paṭipannā āyupaṭilābhāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: For by practicing that way they gain long life

verses.pali: So lābhī hoti āyussa dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
verses.english: as a god or a human being.

verses.pali: Na kho, gahapati, arahati ariyasāvako vaṇṇakāmo vaṇṇaṁ āyācituṁ vā abhinandituṁ vā vaṇṇassa vāpi hetu.
verses.english: A noble disciple who wants to be beautiful ought not pray for it, or hope for it, or pine for it.

verses.pali: Vaṇṇakāmena, gahapati, ariyasāvakena vaṇṇasaṁvattanikā paṭipadā paṭipajjitabbā.
verses.english: Instead, they should practice the way that leads to beauty.

verses.pali: Vaṇṇasaṁvattanikā hissa paṭipadā paṭipannā vaṇṇapaṭilābhāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: For by practicing that way they gain beauty

verses.pali: So lābhī hoti vaṇṇassa dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
verses.english: as a god or a human being.

verses.pali: Na kho, gahapati, arahati ariyasāvako sukhakāmo sukhaṁ āyācituṁ vā abhinandituṁ vā sukhassa vāpi hetu.
verses.english: A noble disciple who wants to be happy ought not pray for it, or hope for it, or pine for it.

verses.pali: Sukhakāmena, gahapati, ariyasāvakena sukhasaṁvattanikā paṭipadā paṭipajjitabbā.
verses.english: Instead, they should practice the way that leads to happiness.

verses.pali: Sukhasaṁvattanikā hissa paṭipadā paṭipannā sukhapaṭilābhāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: For by practicing that way they gain happiness

verses.pali: So lābhī hoti sukhassa dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
verses.english: as a god or a human being.

verses.pali: Na kho, gahapati, arahati ariyasāvako yasakāmo yasaṁ āyācituṁ vā abhinandituṁ vā yasassa vāpi hetu.
verses.english: A noble disciple who wants to be famous ought not pray for it, or hope for it, or pine for it.

verses.pali: Yasakāmena, gahapati, ariyasāvakena yasasaṁvattanikā paṭipadā paṭipajjitabbā.
verses.english: Instead, they should practice the way that leads to fame.

verses.pali: Yasasaṁvattanikā hissa paṭipadā paṭipannā yasapaṭilābhāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: For by practicing that way they gain fame

verses.pali: So lābhī hoti yasassa dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
verses.english: as a god or a human being.

verses.pali: Na kho, gahapati, arahati ariyasāvako saggakāmo saggaṁ āyācituṁ vā abhinandituṁ vā saggānaṁ vāpi hetu.
verses.english: A noble disciple who wants to go to heaven ought not pray for it, or hope for it, or pine for it.

verses.pali: Saggakāmena, gahapati, ariyasāvakena saggasaṁvattanikā paṭipadā paṭipajjitabbā.
verses.english: Instead, they should practice the way that leads to heaven.

verses.pali: Saggasaṁvattanikā hissa paṭipadā paṭipannā saggapaṭilābhāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: For by practicing that way they gain heaven,

verses.pali: So lābhī hoti saggānanti.
verses.english: they are one who gains the heavens.

verses.pali: Āyuṁ vaṇṇaṁ yasaṁ kittiṁ,
verses.english: For one who desires lofty delights

verses.pali: Saggaṁ uccākulīnataṁ;
verses.english: again and again—

verses.pali: Ratiyo patthayānena,
verses.english: long life, beauty, fame and reputation,

verses.pali: Uḷārā aparāparā.
verses.english: heaven, and an eminent family—

verses.pali: Appamādaṁ pasaṁsanti,
verses.english: the astute praise diligence

verses.pali: puññakiriyāsu paṇḍitā;
verses.english: in making merit.

verses.pali: Appamatto ubho atthe,
verses.english: Being diligent, an astute person

verses.pali: adhigaṇhāti paṇḍito.
verses.english: secures both benefits:

verses.pali: Diṭṭhe dhamme ca yo attho,
verses.english: the benefit in this life,

verses.pali: yo cattho samparāyiko;
verses.english: and in lives to come.

verses.pali: Atthābhisamayā dhīro,
verses.english: An attentive one, comprehending the meaning,

verses.pali: paṇḍitoti pavuccatī”ti.
verses.english: is called ‘astute’.”

verses.pali: Tatiyaṁ.
